race.title: Midnite: Built For 2027 Not 2007 Handicap
race.verdict: LEADING TIMES is easily one of the least exposed and found further progress when making a winning stable debut over C&D 3 weeks ago, finding plenty for pressure to edge out Toolatetonegotiate late on. Further progress rates a distinct possibility and he looks a big player again nudged up 2 lb. Sir Yoshi wasn't disgraced last time and faces his easiest assignment for some time, so commands respect despite a poor strike rate. Aforementioned Toolatetonegotiate completes the shortlist. LEADING TIMES SIR YOSHI (IRE) TOOLATETONEGOTIATE
